copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Microsoft Teams 频道、群聊和私信与用户互动。
howto.when: 当用户将技能安装并配置好 Teams 凭据和 Webhook 后，在 Teams 中向机器人发送消息时触发。

say.text: 在 Teams 频道中 @机器人 并说“帮我总结今天的会议”。
say.note: 机器人会回复总结内容。

say.text: 在 Teams 私信中问“我的待办事项有哪些？”
say.note: 机器人会列出待办事项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can interact with users via Microsoft Teams channels, group chats, and direct messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the bot in Teams after the skill is installed and configured with credentials and webhook.

say_en.text: In a Teams channel, @mention the bot and say "Summarize today's meeting."
say_en.note: The bot will reply with a summary.

say_en.text: In a Teams DM, ask "What are my tasks?"
say_en.note: The bot will list your tasks.
